summary:

title: California Woman Loses $14,000 to Mail Theft and Check Washing Fraud As Bank Initially Refuses Reimbursement
summary:

The post California Woman Loses $14,000 to Mail Theft and Check Washing Fraud As Bank Initially Refuses Reimbursement appeared first on The Daily Hodl.
content: An elderly San Francisco resident lost $14,000 due to mail theft and check washing fraud. Thieves stole mailed checks and altered them, leading to significant financial losses amid rising mail theft in the Bay Area. Although her bank initially refused to reimburse the full amount, the victim eventually received a refund after media involvement brought attention to the incident.

title: Court Platform Breach Exposes Social Security Numbers of Americans Across 12 States
summary:
Thomson Reuters' C-Track platform suffered unauthorized access exposing names, SSNs and other sensitive data from appellate courts in 12 U.S. states, the U.S. Virgin Islands and Ontario. The incident lasted from March until detection on June 30, 2026, with no evidence of misuse reported so far.
The post Court Platform Breach Exposes Social Security Numbers of Americans Across 12 States appeared first on The Daily Hodl.
content: Thomson Reuters' C-Track court platform suffered an unauthorized data breach that exposed sensitive information, including Social Security numbers and names. The security incident affected appellate courts across 12 U.S. states, the U.S. Virgin Islands, and Ontario. The unauthorized access occurred over several months before being detected, though officials report no evidence of data misuse at this time.
